13811.name: A Small Crack

north.description: To the north lies Moloch's Repose.

east.description: To the east lies The Stone Of Sealing.

13811.description:
A small crack splits the black rock here, barely wide enough to pass
sideways, its edges smoothed by the passage of something soft and heavy.
A glistening trail of slime runs through it, cold to the touch and
threaded with fine pale hairs. A faint warmth breathes from the north,
where the crack opens on a pit of old iron and older dread. To the east
the fissure ends against a vast slab of carved stone.

13849.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13849.description:
This Hot Cave Tunnel is warm with a feverish, rotten heat, as if the
rock itself were running a sickness. Damp air clings like breath on the
neck, and it carries the sweet stench of meat gone bad. The walls weep a
thin grey slime that steams faintly in the gloom. A cold pale glimmer
lies along the passage east, while the tunnel sinks south into a closer,
fouler warmth.

13850.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Natural Lava-Chamber.

13850.description:
A Hot Cave Tunnel runs broad and low through reddened rock, and the
warmth here is wrong: damp and close, like air breathed out by some
great sleeping thing. Frozen ropes of old lava twist along the floor,
and bones are caught in them like flies in amber. A dim, dying orange
gleam spills from a hollow to the west. The tunnel runs north and south.

13851.name: Natural Lava-Chamber

east.description: To the east lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13851.description:
The Natural Lava-Chamber is a huge bubble in the rock, its floor a lake
of lava that has all but died, a black crust shot with thin, failing
veins of red. Bones lie heaped along the shore, and skulls sit half sunk
in the slag like stones in a frozen pond. The last of the heat rises in
slow, sour breaths. The only path out is the tunnel east.

13852.name: A Hot Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies The Fire Vein.

13852.description:
The Hot Cave Tunnel narrows here, its walls sweating a warm, rank
moisture that smells of rot. Gusts of foul breath push in from a gap at
the end, carrying a low moan that might be wind and might not. Orc
skeletons lie where they fell along the dry, cracked floor, their bones
blackened. The tunnel runs north, and the passage opens east on a dim
red cut in the rock.

13853.name: The Fire Vein

south.description: To the south lies On A Stone Ledge.

west.description: To the west lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13853.description:
The Fire Vein was once a river of molten rock; now it is a sluggish seam
of dull embers crawling through a crust of black slag. Charred skeletons
lie half sunk in the cooling stone, caught mid-stride as they tried to
cross. The heat comes in weak, sick pulses, and between them the cold of
the tombs creeps back. The hot tunnel lies west, and a narrow shelf of
stone continues south.

13854.name: On A Stone Ledge

north.description: To the north lies The Fire Vein.

west.description: To the west lies At The Entrance To The Under Tombs.

13854.description:
On A Stone Ledge the way narrows to a crumbling shelf above a chasm of
utter darkness. Far below, pale shapes shift and glimmer, and the faint
clatter of bone on bone drifts out of the depths. A cold draught rises
from the chasm, carrying the smell of damp earth and old death. The
ledge runs north towards a dull red glow, and west towards a dark
archway.

13855.name: At The Entrance To The Under Tombs

east.description: To the east lies On A Stone Ledge.

down.description: To the down lies The Hall Of Mirrors.

13855.description:
At The Entrance To The Under Tombs, an archway of black stone is carved
with a ring of pallid faces, their eyes closed and mouths open in silent
song. Someone has gouged out several of the faces and carved new ones in
their place, each with far too many eyes. A cold, sweet air drifts from
within, smelling of grave-wax. The ledge lies east, and worn stairs
spiral steeply down into the dark.

extra_descs.faces archway carved faces:
A ring of pale stone faces circles the arch, each one different, lips
parted in the middle of a hymn. Several have been chiselled away and
recut with clusters of staring eyes, crude but fresh, as though the work
were done from the other side.

13856.name: The Hall Of Mirrors

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall Of The Pale.

up.description: To the up lies At The Entrance To The Under Tombs.

13856.description:
The Hall Of Mirrors is a long gallery lined with tall panels of black
glass, each framed in tarnished silver. In them your reflection moves a
moment too late, and sometimes shows a bare skull grinning beneath your
face. Behind the reflections, pale figures stand in rows, waiting. The
air is bitterly cold and perfectly still. A door at the far end leads
south into a great hall, and a stair climbs up to the entrance.

extra_descs.mirrors panels glass:
The black glass shows your own shape, but off by a breath, and the room
behind you is full of quiet, pale watchers who are never there when you
turn.

13857.name: The Great Hall Of The Pale

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Mirrors.

south.description: To the south lies The Stone Of Sealing.

13857.description:
The Great Hall Of The Pale is a vast chamber of white stone, its ceiling
lost in shadow and its floor laid with rows of stone slabs. Many slabs
have been shoved aside from beneath, leaving open graves. Tall pillars
carved as robed figures hold the vault aloft, each wearing the same
serene, empty smile. Cold blue light falls from no visible source. A
door north leads to the mirrors, and another south leads on towards a
great stone.

13858.name: The Tomb Of The Pale

north.description: To the north lies The Stone Of Sealing.

south.description: To the south lies Moloch's Repose.

13858.description:
The Tomb Of The Pale is a long chamber of grey stone, lined with niches
that once held the bodies of an ancient sect in bleached linen. Most
niches now stand empty, their wrappings torn open from the inside and
trailing across the floor. Those still occupied turn waxen faces towards
the passage, eyes sewn shut, lips moving without sound. The tomb runs
north to a great carved stone and south towards a faint, unwholesome
warmth.

13859.name: Moloch's Repose

south.description: To the south lies A Small Crack.

13859.description:
Moloch's Repose is a vaulted pit of black stone, colder at its edges
than any tomb, yet warm at its heart like a sleeper's breath. A great
sarcophagus of fused obsidian lies on a cracked dais, its iron chains
snapped and hanging loose. Within the split lid a few embers still
pulse, dull red and slow as a heartbeat. Bones of the Pale lie scattered
where they fell trying to hold it shut. The only way out is the small
crack to the south.

extra_descs.sarcophagus obsidian chains:
The obsidian lid is split from end to end, and the iron chains that
bound it hang in snapped links, bent outward. Inside, a bed of dull
embers still breathes, and the shape pressed into them is far larger
than any man.

13862.name: The Stone Of Sealing

south.description: To the south lies The Tomb Of The Pale.

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall Of The Pale.

13862.description:
The Stone Of Sealing stands upright in the cave wall, a slab of pale
rock as wide as a barn door, carved edge to edge with warding glyphs. A
long crack now runs through its centre, and from it seeps a faint,
feverish warmth that smells of ash and old blood. Most of the glyphs
have gone dark; a few still flicker a dying red. The great hall lies
north, and the Tomb Of The Pale runs south.

13863.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

13863.description:
A rough granite stair climbs up out of the Glowing Tunnel here, flanked
by the charred stumps of an orc barricade that did not hold. Crude
warding marks are daubed on every stone in black blood: a crossed-out
eye, a skull, a clawed hand raised to halt. Cold blue light seeps from
the tunnels north, south and west, and with it a low murmur of whispers.
Beyond this point lies the dead country, where only the strongest go on;
the steps lead up towards the orc warrens.

extra_descs.barricade marks warning:
The orcs piled timber, shields and their own dead across the stair, and
daubed every stone with signs against what lay below. The barricade was
burned from the far side. Scratched beneath the marks, in rough orcish,
is a single word: turn.

13864.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13864.description:
Long and straight, the tunnel runs here between walls banded black, grey
and bone-white like the layers of an old grave. Fallen slabs lie across
the floor, and from beneath one a skeletal arm still twitches its
fingers at intervals. A faint marsh-light floats ahead, always a few
paces out of reach. The tunnel goes north and south.

13865.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13865.description:
Two long cracks meet at this bend, and from the seam between them rises
a thin, cold mist that glows like moonlight on water. The rock on either
side is blistered and pitted, as if something acid had once been poured
along it. A chill draught sighs through the passage, carrying fragments
of words in no living tongue. The tunnel leads north, and west around
the corner.

13866.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13866.description:
The walls are pocked with hundreds of small holes, as though the stone
were a sponge, and in every one a faint blue spark glimmers like a
watching pupil. The floor is rutted and strewn with shards of black
glass and the brittle shells of some burrowing thing. A soft, wet
gibbering drifts from behind the rock, then stops. Here the tunnel
bends, running north and east.

13867.name: A Glowing Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13867.description:
A heap of collapsed rock fills half of this sharp turn, and pressed into
the rubble are the orcs it buried, grey and dried like old leather. A
pale phosphorescence creeps over them in fine threads, as if the fungus
were slowly sewing them together. One of the faces has opened its eyes.
The tunnel continues south or west from here.

13868.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13868.description:
High and narrow, the roof of this passage is streaked white where
mineral water once ran, and it now hangs with ribbons of pale fungus
that shed a dim, cold glow. Brittle crusts crack underfoot, and among
them lie the small, gnawed bones of rats and worse. The air smells of
wet stone and old graves. The tunnel winds north and east.

13869.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13869.description:
Rows of ancient runes are cut into the walls, the script of the Pale,
and they still shine with a frail silver light. Someone has hacked
across many of them with an axe, and wherever a mark was broken the
stone has turned black and slick. Shards of funerary pottery crunch
underfoot, spilling grey ash. The passage runs east and south.

13870.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13870.description:
Three ways join in a ragged hollow, its ceiling lost in a slow-turning
haze of ghost-light. Drifts of bone dust have gathered along the walls,
and through them runs a broad, glistening trail of slime that seems to
lead everywhere at once. Old pick marks on the stone show where orc
miners first broke into this place. Passages lead north, east and west.

13871.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13871.description:
This short, straight run has walls glazed smooth as a kiln jar, and in
the glaze are trapped faint faces that drift slowly towards the surface.
Footsteps ring loudly here, and something beneath the floor answers each
one with a soft knock. A cold sheen rises from the cracks between the
flagstones. The way leads on north, and back south.

13872.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13872.description:
A sooty vault opens where three passages meet, its seams shot through
with a cold, flickering glow like lightning seen through cloud. Against
one wall lies a heap of splintered orc shields, stacked as if someone
had begun a last barricade and abandoned it. A slow rasping, like
enormous breath, rises and falls within the stone. Ways lead north, east
and south.

13873.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13873.description:
At this bend the tunnel opens into a small chamber with a smooth,
scorched floor, the old burn long since gone cold. Soot blackens the
walls, and across it a hundred tiny eyes have been painted in luminous
white, all watching the middle of the room. Fragments of charred bone
lie in the cinders, arranged with care into rings. Ways lead east, west
and south from here.

extra_descs.eyes painted eyes:
Each painted eye is a different size, and the luminous paint is bone ash
mixed with something that still glistens. Stand in the middle of the
room and every one of them seems to look straight at you.

13874.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13874.description:
This stretch of the Glowing Tunnel slopes gently, its floor worn into a
smooth channel by countless feet that only ever went one way. Drops of
cold water hang from the ceiling and shine faintly blue before they
fall. At the lowest point a dead orc sits propped against the wall, axe
across his knees, his skull split and empty. The tunnel runs north and
south from here.

extra_descs.orc corpse dead orc:
The orc is a veteran, scarred and heavily armoured, his axe notched from
a hard fight. His skull has been opened neatly at the crown and scooped
clean, and there is no sign that he ever lifted the axe.

13875.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13875.description:
Sharp crystals stud the walls of this narrow throat, each glowing a dim,
bloodless white like a candle seen through fog. They have been gnawed:
tooth-marks score the nearest clusters, and splinters lie among cracked
bones on the floor. The cold here aches in the teeth, and every breath
hangs in the air. The tunnel runs north and west.

13876.name: A Glowing Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13876.description:
Here the tunnel curves around a pillar of pale, waxy rock that gleams
with a faint inner light. Its polished face shows reflections, though
not always of whatever stands before it; now and then an eye opens in
the stone, and slowly closes again. Frost rimes the floor around its
base. The passage drops south towards a wider space and runs west back
along the tunnel.

13877.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13877.description:
A crust of iridescent mineral runs the length of this low passage,
shining violet and sickly green in a light that seems to come from
within the stone. Fine pale dust covers the floor, broken by the tracks
of many small, stiff legs. Far off, something grinds slowly against rock
with a patient rhythm, then falls silent as though listening. The tunnel
runs east and west, each way as cold as the last.

13878.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13878.description:
Three ways meet in a small round junction, its roof lost behind a
drifting pall of grey cobweb. Cold motes of light sift through the
webbing like snow, settling on heaps of mouldered orc armour along the
walls. Every helmet has been cracked open at the crown, cleanly, and
scooped hollow. Passages lead east and west along the Glowing Tunnel,
and another runs south.

13879.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13879.description:
Broad and sloping, the tunnel has a ribbed floor slick with old frost
and scattered bone dust. Deep scratches score the walls in long parallel
lines, far too many for any one hand, and they glow a faint corpse-green
where the rock was laid open. Somewhere in the stone a voice whispers a
name over and over. The way runs east towards a junction and south to
the narrower reaches.

13880.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13880.description:
Ossuary niches are cut into both walls here, each stacked neatly with
long bones and capped with a grinning skull. Pale ghost-light drifts
between them like breath on a frosty morning, gathering and fading with
no wind to move it. Several niches have been raked empty, their contents
strewn across the floor and gnawed. The passage runs north towards a
brighter shimmer and west along the way back.

13881.name: A Glowing Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Glowing Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13881.description:
Low and narrow, this stretch of tunnel forces a stoop beneath a roof
studded with skulls. Hundreds are mortared into the stone, orc and far
older, and a faint blue phosphor gleams in every empty socket. The air
is cold enough to mist your breath. A soft clicking, like chattering
teeth, follows anyone who passes. The tunnel turns east, and returns
south the way it came.

13882.name: A Glowing Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Glowing Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Hot Cave Tunnel.

13882.description:
Bone-white lichen grows in thick mats along this bend of the Glowing
Tunnel, giving off a cold, greenish shine that never flickers. Crude orc
warnings are scratched into the walls, their painted eyes long dried to
brown. Something has scraped the lichen away in a wide, wet swath at
knee height, and the smear still glistens. The tunnel turns north, and a
warmer passage lies back west.

651400.name: carrion crawler worm aberration
651400.long_desc: A carrion crawler clings to the tunnel wall, its feelers twitching toward you.
651400.description:
A pale, segmented worm-thing as long as a cart, with a dozen clawed legs
and a ring of writhing feelers about its mouth. A touch of those feelers
numbs a man stiff while it feeds.

651401.name: gibbering mouther aberration mouths
651401.long_desc: A gibbering mouther heaves across the floor, a dozen mouths babbling at once.
651401.description:
A shapeless heap of pale flesh studded with eyes and mouths that open
and close at random, each one babbling. The ground softens under it, and
its gibbering fills the head with noise.

651402.name: wraith mirror ghost
651402.long_desc: A mirror wraith slides out of a black pane, a silvery ghost wearing a dozen stolen faces.
651402.description:
A shape of cold silver mist that mimics your face as you look on it. Its
hands end in shards of broken glass.

651403.name: cultist pale risen corpse
651403.long_desc: A risen pale cultist kneels on the cold stone, its dead lips still shaping prayers.
651403.description:
A gaunt corpse in a bone-white robe stitched with silver thread, its
chalk-white skin drawn tight over the skull. It died praying to keep the
seal, and it prays still, though not to the same master.

651404.name: colossus bone giant
651404.long_desc: A bone colossus stands among the embers, a giant built of a thousand skeletons.
651404.description:
A towering figure stitched together from the bones of hundreds of orcs,
skulls packed into its chest like stones in a wall. A dying red glow
burns in its ribcage, and every step grinds like a millstone.

651405.name: knight pale skeleton armoured
651405.long_desc: A pale knight in bone-coloured plate stands watch beside the slabs, a long sword held before him.
651405.description:
A dead warrior in ancient white armour, pale light shining from the
slits of his helm. His shield bears a faded face with closed eyes.

651406.name: imrael priest pale high lich
651406.short_desc: Imrael the Lich, Pale High Priest
651406.long_desc: Imrael the Lich, Pale High Priest, stands in the Hall of Mirrors, a robed skeleton of ash and silver.
651406.description:
A tall figure in robes of pale grey, its face a silver mask over bare
bone. It holds a staff topped with a ring of cold flame, and its
reflection in the glass does not match its movements. It kept the seal
for a thousand years, and broke it.

651407.name: moloch demon lord ancient
651407.long_desc: Moloch, the Ancient Demon Lord, rises from his sarcophagus among the bones, wreathed in the last of hell-fire.
651407.description:
A towering demon with the horns of a ram and skin like cooling lava,
wings folded about him like a smoking cloak. It was his waking that
loosed the dead on Morkai, and every bone in the tombs leans toward him.

751400.name: grave ember heart stone
751400.room_desc: A dull red stone, cold to the touch, lies here.
751400.description: A stone the size of a fist with a slow red ember trapped inside it, cold to hold though it glows. Jewellers will buy it, but they will not keep it overnight.

751401.name: mirror shard dagger glass
751401.room_desc: A dagger made of black mirror glass lies here.
751401.description: A slender dagger ground from a shard of black mirror-glass, its edge bright as ice. Your reflection in the blade never quite matches your face.

751402.name: pale knight shield white
751402.room_desc: A white shield painted with a sleeping face lies here.
751402.description: A heavy kite shield of bleached steel, painted with a closed-eyed face. It is cold to the touch even in the cave's heat.

751403.name: pale priest mantle grey cloak
751403.room_desc: A silver-threaded grey mantle lies here.
751403.description: A long mantle of ash-grey cloth embroidered with silver faces, each with closed eyes. It hangs on the shoulders as if made of cold mist.

751404.name: moloch hellblade sword black
751404.room_desc: A black greatsword with a molten edge lies here, glowing.
751404.description: A huge blade of black iron with an edge that still glows dull red, as though newly drawn from the forge. The hilt is wrapped in blistered leather, and the heat of it can be felt from across the room.
